scope: direct loading and durable interpretation reuse
invalidation: fixed-place intent and flexible place preferences
reuse: Google coordinate lease expiry without changed fixed-place intent
interruption_policy: Persist pending before dispatch and completed before callback. Uncertain pending, failed or corrupt outcomes require explicit retry; no automatic duplicate generation.
limits: Only new completed responses can populate this journal; the old memory-only build cannot be recovered after update.
Retains interpretation results, not unaccepted review checkboxes or route estimates.
Bounded snapshot eviction and model/prompt changes can require a fresh interpretation.
